name: shuip
summary: Docs for shuip, business-ready React form and dialog components built on shadcn/ui for Next.js apps.
description: shuip turns shadcn/ui primitives into business-ready components: a submit button with automatic loading state, input fields with Zod validation and error handling, a confirmation dialog, and date/time/autocomplete fields. Components install via the shadcn CLI and integrate with React Hook Form, TanStack Form and TanStack Query.
contains: business-ready components on top of shadcn/ui primitives
integrations: React Hook Form, TanStack Form, TanStack Query
fields: input, select, checkbox, radio, date, date range, datetime, month, time, time range, autocomplete
components: confirmation dialog, side dialog, submit button, theme button, search input, copy button
CLI installs only the components you need; 100% open source under MIT
